priorityList: Use Shadow Blades only when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready.
Use Shadow Dance if you are not in stealth and have low Combo Points, provided Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Vanish to enter stealth/Subterfuge if you have 1 or fewer Combo Points.
Spend Combo Points at 5 or more (or 6 if Darkest Night is active).
Cast Secret Technique as your top priority finisher during Shadow Dance or if it will be available again for your next Dance window.
Cast Eviscerate as a priority finisher whenever the Darkest Night buff is active, even in AoE.
Cast Coup de Grace if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Cast Black Powder as your finisher against 3 or more targets if higher priority finishers (Secret Tech, Darkest Night Eviscerate, Coup de Grace) are unavailable.
Use Shuriken Storm as your primary builder whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Use Shadowstrike while in Stealth or Shadow Dance to consume Unseen Blade procs or if Darkest Night is active on 4 or fewer targets.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Sync your offensive trinkets, potions, and racials with your Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance burst windows.
